note: DL is NOT a downloadable-PDF-fill flow like the certificates above. It runs through the Sarathi/Parivahan web portal (sarathi.parivahan.gov.in), is state-RTO administered, and requires OTP/Aadhaar e-KYC auth that this tool should not touch directly. Output here is a field-by-field prep sheet in portal order, not an auto-filled PDF.

fields_needed_in_portal_order.note: actual Aadhaar auth happens on portal via OTP — we never submit this on user's behalf

documents_to_keep_ready: Aadhaar card (for e-KYC OTP on portal)
Address proof if Aadhaar address is outdated
sub_flows.sequence_note_hi: पहले ऑनलाइन टेस्ट (traffic rules quiz) स्लॉट बुक करना ज़रूरी है, फॉर्म भरने के तुरंत बाद।

sub_flows.prerequisite: Must hold a valid learner's license for at least 30 days
documents_to_keep_ready: Form 1A (medical certificate) — required if applying for transport/commercial vehicle class or applicant age 40+
sub_flows.sequence_note_hi: स्थायी लाइसेंस के लिए ड्राइविंग टेस्ट स्लॉट बुक करना होगा — RTO में शारीरिक उपस्थिति ज़रूरी है।

explicit_non_goals: Do NOT auto-submit to sarathi.parivahan.gov.in on the user's behalf in v1 — Aadhaar e-KYC/OTP flows carry authentication and liability risk that isn't worth taking on before the rest of the product is proven.
Do NOT store full Aadhaar or DL numbers — last-4 only, same as other forms.
Revisit browser-automation fill-assist only after prep-mode is validated with real users and RTO portal stability is confirmed over a few months.
